patch.value: Preserve published claims with append-only release corrections

Record explicitly linked post-publication factual corrections, preserving immutable milestone wording and exposing the correction chain in a current view. Overlap rechecked against CLI and sibling source: claim-audit validates before publication; pm-evidence owns source-fragment validity; core owns item history, annotations and transactional coordination. No existing release correction chain found.

Replay creates no duplicate correction; supersession cycle refuses; historical output remains byte-identical while a current view exposes original and corrected wording with evidence. Typed SDK and CLI, strict bounded inputs, compact TOON/JSON, non-git and real public-tracker validation, seeded model and concurrency proofs, packed npm/Bun acceptance and CI npm/Bun release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Design: native SDK comments retain versioned correction envelopes; immutable milestone fingerprint plus predecessor revision binds replay identity. Core workspace transaction serializes chain changes, SDK annotation append-if-absent owns normalization/history. Each apply and retry re-reads the target through the SDK; historical generation is unchanged. Current view exposes original wording, each corrected wording and evidence. Malformed and foreign records are skipped independently. No item create/update or journaled multi-target plan is introduced.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: SDK capability audit found native structured context events (notes addJson), which core treats as immutable and refuses to edit/delete. Corrections now use those events instead of mutable plain comments. Complete internal reads explicitly disable SDK row/token output compaction and enforce annotation/chain bounds; the seeded model exposed the earlier incomplete-read defect. Real public baseline validation: 202 items, 189 done-role items, 202 frozen members, 15130 historical bytes, 2 new corrections, replay 0, chain length 2, 29 native fields unchanged, source tree byte-identical. Source copy is filesystem read-only; mutations occur only in a disposable non-git overlay.

value.text: Round-2 class fix: schema-2 milestones freeze SDK-classified doneItemIds inside the fingerprint at capture. Ownership and correction replay never consult current custom roles; schema-1 retains released SDK-default semantics and original fingerprints. Live Unreleased eligibility is separate per item, and generation plus selection diagnostics share one predicate; explicit status filters override it. Whole-package audit found and fixed both historical attribution and historical rendering/diagnostics. Behavioral revert proofs each fail with AssertionError when reverting only (1) createReleaseMilestone to the old producer (schema 1 versus expected 2), (2) resolveTrackerReleaseLedger to current-role interpretation (v1 steals v2), or (3) the status predicate to default name filtering (published wording disappears). Sources restored byte-for-byte. Focused related suite 48 passed; final publication regression file 5 passed, zero failures/skips/cancels. Seed 0x291f2 runs 500 registry/JSON/TOON/older-producer-replay sequences with SDK-read correction/native state. A fixture emitted by the released main producer proves legacy read, round trips, correction append/replay and immutable bytes. Dense arrays, duplicates, foreign IDs, hidden properties, non-finite values and a maximum-length sparse array refuse before side effects; oversized eligibility refuses before JSON conversion.
